objectives: Identificar la función de una frase corta antes de ver las opciones.
Reconocer distractores de sonido y de tema.
Seguir la estructura problema → opciones → decisión en diálogos de campus.

words: to form or make up a whole
Women constitute half of the research team.
the situation or text surrounding a word or event
You can guess the meaning from the context.
The architects created a sustainable design.
facts and numbers collected for analysis
The data show a clear trend.
to explain the exact meaning of something
Define the key terms before you begin.
to give out or spread among people
The university distributes grants every spring.
the system of money, trade and industry of a country
The economy grew by two percent.
Plastic waste harms the marine environment.

videos.search: TOEFL iBT 2026 Listen and Choose a Response strategy

practice.title: Listen and Choose a Response (5 frases)
practice.intro: Escucha **una vez** cada frase (límite de reproducciones: 2 para practicar) y elige la respuesta más natural.

items.q: Listen and choose the best response.
options: Sure, the deadline is next Monday.
I did not go to the beach.
items.explain: «When is the essay due?» pide una fecha; solo A la da.

segments.text: Do you remember when the essay is due?

items.q: Listen and choose the best response.
options: Go ahead. I am finished with it.
items.explain: «Is anyone using this chair?»/«Can I borrow your notes?» son peticiones; la respuesta debe conceder o negar.

segments.text: Can I borrow your notes from yesterday's class?

items.q: Listen and choose the best response.
options: I am afraid the room is already taken.
items.explain: Quien pregunta si hay salas libres espera disponibilidad; «I'm afraid… taken» es una negativa cortés.

segments.text: Is the study room on the second floor available this afternoon?

items.q: Listen and choose the best response.
options: Why don't you try the tutoring center?
items.explain: Una queja/preocupación («I'm lost in calculus») invita a una sugerencia útil.

segments.text: I'm completely lost in my calculus class, and the exam is next week.

items.q: Listen and choose the best response.
options: It's not a problem. I can wait.
The professor has a new car.
items.explain: Alguien se disculpa por llegar tarde: lo natural es restar importancia.

segments.text: I'm so sorry I'm late. The bus broke down.
Hi, I'm in room 308, and I have a problem with the heating. It hasn't worked since Sunday.
I'm sorry to hear that. Did you report it online?
I tried, but the website was down. So I'm here in person.
Okay. I can send a technician tomorrow morning, but he'll need access to the room between nine and eleven. Will you be there?
I have a class at ten, unfortunately. Could he come in the afternoon instead?
Let me check. Yes, there's a slot at two o'clock. In the meantime, I can lend you a small heater. You'll have to sign a form for it.
That would be great, thank you.

options: The heating in her room does not work
The website asks for a password
items.explain: «I have a problem with the heating. It hasn't worked since Sunday».

items.q: Why did the student come in person?
options: She wanted to meet the technician
items.explain: «I tried, but the website was down. So I'm here in person».

items.q: Why does the student reject the morning appointment?
options: She will be at a class
She does not trust the technician
items.explain: «I have a class at ten» y el técnico necesita acceso entre nueve y once.

items.q: What will the student have to do to get the heater?
items.explain: «You'll have to sign a form for it».

quiz.q: In a conversation, the phrase "I'm afraid we're fully booked" most likely expresses
"Would you mind if I sat here?" Which answer means YES, you can sit?
quiz.explain: «Not at all» = no me molesta = puedes sentarte.

quiz.q: In a campus conversation, which note is MOST useful?
options: The exact words of every sentence
quiz.explain: La estructura problema/opciones/decisión resume casi cualquier diálogo.

quiz.q: "Do you know where the registration office is?" Which is a distractor (wrong answer by sound)?
options: I know that she registered late.
quiz.explain: Repite «register…» pero no responde dónde está la oficina.
